title: Planning Git access
responsibility: Provide repository reads and validate artifact paths and local Git LFS image content.

inputs.name: planGit.root
inputs.description: Filesystem path canonicalized before Git is queried. It must resolve to the repository root itself; a nested directory raises not-a-repository.

inputs.name: containing.git
inputs.description: Git handle whose run callback executes commands for the selected repository. The handle also supplies the repository root and Git directory; its runner may reject when a Git command fails.

inputs.name: containing.rev
inputs.description: Revision passed to git log to search for the path's creation. Git determines whether the revision is valid.

inputs.name: containing.path
inputs.description: Pathspec passed to git log after --; the function returns the oldest commit in that history that added the path. It raises artifact-tampered when no creation commit is found.

inputs.name: revision.git
inputs.description: Git handle whose run callback executes commands for the selected repository. The handle also supplies the repository root and Git directory; its runner may reject when a Git command fails.

inputs.name: revision.value
inputs.description: Revision name resolved as a commit by git rev-parse; defaults to HEAD. Empty, leading-hyphen, NUL, CR, and LF values are rejected, as are names Git cannot resolve to a commit.

inputs.name: paths.git
inputs.description: Git handle whose run callback executes commands for the selected repository. The handle also supplies the repository root and Git directory; its runner may reject when a Git command fails.

inputs.name: paths.rev
inputs.description: Revision whose tree is passed to git ls-tree. Git determines whether the revision is valid.

inputs.name: paths.path
inputs.description: Pathspec passed to git ls-tree; the empty-string default is converted to . to list the whole tree. Git applies the pathspec matching rules.

inputs.name: blob.git
inputs.description: Git handle whose run callback executes commands for the selected repository. The handle also supplies the repository root and Git directory; its runner may reject when a Git command fails.

inputs.name: blob.rev
inputs.description: Revision used to locate and read the artifact from the Git tree. Git determines whether the revision is valid.

inputs.name: blob.path
inputs.description: Repository path used for the tree lookup and git show. It must identify an existing regular-file entry with mode 100644 or 100755, or the call raises an artifact error.

inputs.name: imageBlob.git
inputs.description: Git handle whose run callback executes commands for the selected repository. The handle also supplies the repository root and Git directory; its runner may reject when a Git command fails.

inputs.name: imageBlob.rev
inputs.description: Revision used to locate the Git LFS pointer for the image content. Git determines whether the revision is valid.

inputs.name: imageBlob.path
inputs.description: Repository path whose regular-file blob is expected to contain a Git LFS pointer. The pointer must match the supported version, SHA-256 object ID, and size format.

inputs.name: safePath.git
inputs.description: Git handle supplying the root beneath which path components are checked. The function uses the root field and does not run a Git command.

inputs.name: safePath.path
inputs.description: Slash-separated path traversed beneath git.root. Empty, . or .. segments and existing symbolic-link components raise unsafe-path; missing components are allowed.

outputs.name: planGit
outputs.description: Git handle rooted at the canonical repository path, with its absolute Git directory and a runner that executes Git in that root. objectFormat is included only when Git reports sha1 or sha256; the runner callback cannot be represented in JSON.

outputs.name: revision
outputs.description: Full commit object ID returned by git rev-parse --verify. Its length follows the repository object format.

outputs.name: paths
outputs.description: Repository paths emitted by git ls-tree for the selected revision and pathspec; the array may be empty.

outputs.name: blob
outputs.description: Raw Buffer bytes returned by git show for an existing tree entry with regular-file mode 100644 or 100755. Other entry modes are rejected.

outputs.name: imageBlob
outputs.description: Raw local Git LFS object bytes returned after validating the pointer and checking the object's SHA-256 and declared size. Missing or malformed pointers and missing or mismatched content are rejected.

outputs.name: safePath
outputs.description: Resolves with undefined after checking each path component beneath git.root. It rejects unsafe segments and existing symbolic links, and tolerates components that do not exist.

outputs.name: containing
outputs.description: Full commit object ID of the oldest commit returned by git log that added the requested path. It raises artifact-tampered if no creation commit is present in the searched history.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: ExpectedCliError is raised for the domain failures emitted through fail: a non-root repository selection, a missing creation commit, an invalid or unknown revision, a missing or non-regular artifact, a malformed or corrupt LFS pointer, a missing or tampered LFS object, or an unsafe path.

inputs.name: planGit.root

outputs.name: planGit
outputs.description: Git handle rooted at the canonical repository path, with its absolute Git directory and a runner that executes Git in that root. objectFormat is included only when Git reports sha1 or sha256; the runner callback cannot be represented in JSON.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Raised as not-a-repository when the canonical selected path differs from Git's reported top level.

outputs.name: containing
outputs.description: Full commit object ID of the oldest commit returned by git log that added the requested path. It raises artifact-tampered if no creation commit is present in the searched history.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Raised as unknown-revision for rejected revision text or when Git cannot resolve the value to a commit.

inputs.name: paths.git

inputs.name: blob.git

inputs.name: blob.rev

inputs.name: blob.path

outputs.name: blob

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Raised as artifact-missing when the tree lookup is empty, or unsafe-path when the tree entry is not a regular file.

inputs.name: imageBlob.git

outputs.description: Raw local Git LFS object bytes returned after validating the pointer and checking the object's SHA-256 and declared size. Missing or malformed pointers and missing or mismatched content are rejected.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Raised for a missing or non-regular pointer entry, a non-LFS or malformed pointer, missing LFS content, or an LFS object's hash or size mismatch.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
